p: the undefiled in the way: Here they are not called blessed who think themselves wise in their own judgment, nor who imagine to themselves a certain holiness, but they whose conversation is without hypocrisy.
no iniquity: For they are ruled by God's Spirit and embrace no doctrine but his.
O that my ways were directed: David acknowledges his imperfection, desiring God to reform it, that his life may be conformable to God's word.
heart: For true religion stands in serving God without hypocrisy.
judgments: That is, your precepts, which contain perfect righteousness.
utterly: He does not refuse to be tried by temptations, but he fears to faint, if God does not help his infirmity in time.
young man cleanse his way: Because youth is most given to licentiousness, he chiefly warns them to frame their lives after God's word.
hid in mine heart: If God's word is carved in our hearts, we will be more able to resist the assaults of Satan: and therefore the prophet desires God to instruct him daily more and more in it.
rejoiced in the way of thy: The prophet does not boast of his virtues, but sets forth an example for others to follow God's word, and leave worldly vanities.
live: He shows that we should not desire to live but to serve God, and that we can not serve him correctly unless he opens our eyes and minds.
stranger in the earth: Seeing man's life in this world is only a passage, what should become of him, if your word were not his guide?
hast rebuked the proud that are: In all ages you have plagued all such who maliciously and contemptuously depart from your truth.
Princes also did sit and speak: When the powers of the world gave false sentence against me, your word was a guide and counsellor to teach me what to do, and to comfort me.
dust: That is, it is almost brought to the grave and without your word I cannot live.
declared my ways: I have confessed my offences and now depend wholly on you.
word: If God did not maintain us by his word, our life would drop away like water.
way of lying: Instruct me in your word, by which my mind may be purged from vanity and taught to obey your will.
enlarge my heart: By this he shows that we can neither choose good, cleave to God's word, nor turn forward in his way, unless he make our hearts large to receive grace, and willing to obey.
me: He shows that he cannot follow on to the end, unless God teaches him often and leads him forward.
heart: Not only in outward conversation, but also with inward affection.
covetousness: By this, meaning all other vices, because covetousness is the root of all evil.
eyes from beholding vanity: Meaning, all his senses.
my reproach which I fear: Let me not fall to your dishonour but let my heart still delight in your gracious word.
quicken me in thy righteousness: Give me strength to continue in your word even to the end.
mercies come also unto me: He shows that God's mercy and love is the first reason for our salvation.
have wherewith to answer him that: By trusting in God's word he assures himself to be able to confute the slanders of his adversaries.
walk at liberty: They who simply walk after God's word have no nets to entangle them, while they who do contrary are ever in nets and snares.
kings: He shows that the children of God should not permit their fathers glory to be obscured by the vain pomp of princes.
the word unto thy servant: Though he feels God's hand still lies on him, yet he rests on his promise, and comforts himself in it.
proud have had me greatly in: Meaning the wicked who contemn God's word, and tread his religion under foot.
judgments of old: That is, the examples, by which you declare yourself to be judge of the world.
Horror hath taken hold upon me: That is, a vehement zeal to your glory and indignation against the wicked.
pilgrimage: In the course of this life and sorrowful exit.
night: Even when others sleep.
This I had: That is, all these benefits.
portion: I am persuaded that to keep your law is a heritage and great gain for me.
ways: He shows that no one can embrace the word of God, unless he considers his own imperfections and ways.
robbed me: They have gone about to draw me into their company.
companion of all them that fear: Not only in mutual consent, but also with aid and help.
teach me thy statutes: For the knowledge of God's word is a singular token of his favour.
well with thy servant: Having proved by experience that God was true in his promise, he desires that he would increase in him knowledge and judgment.
afflicted I went astray: So Jeremiah says, that before the Lord touched him, he was like a calf untamed so that the use of God's rod is to call us home to God.
Their heart is as fat as: Their heart is indurate and hardened, puffed up with prosperity and vain estimation of themselves.
good for me that I have: He confesses that before he was chastened he was rebellious as man by nature is.
made me and fashioned me: Because God does not leave his work that he has begun, he desires a new grace: that is, that he would continue his mercies.
fear thee will be glad when: When God shows his grace toward any, he testifies to others that he does not fail them who trust in him.
live: He declares that when he did not feel God's mercies, he was as dead.
turn unto me: That is, be comforted by my example.
known thy testimonies: He shows that there can be no true fear of God without the knowledge of his word.
fainteth for thy salvation: Though my strength fails me, yet my soul groans and sighs, resting still in your word.
bottle in the smoke: Like a skin bottle or bladder that is parched in the smoke.
days of thy servant: How long will you afflict your servant.
digged pits for me: They have not only oppressed me violently but also craftily conspired against me.
help thou me: He assures himself that God will deliver his and destroy such as unjustly persecute them.
me upon earth: Finding no help on earth, he lifts up his eyes to heaven.
heaven: Because no one should esteem God's word according to the changes of things in this world, he shows that it abides in heaven, and therefore is immutable.
continue this day according to thine: Seeing the earth and all creatures remain in that estate in which you have created them, much more your truth remains constant and unchangeable.
thine: He proves by effect that he is God's child, because he seeks to understand his word.
have seen an end of all: There is nothing so perfect in earth, but it has an end, only God's word lasts forever.
all the day: He shows that we cannot love God's word unless we exercise ourselves in it and practise it.

understanding than all my teachers: Whoever submits himself only to God's word will not only be safe against the practises of his enemies, but also learn more wisdom than they who profess it, and are men of experience.
thou hast taught me: So then of ourselves we can do nothing, but when God inwardly instructs us with his spirit, we feel his graces sweeter than honey.
lamp unto my feet: Of ourselves we are but darkness and cannot see unless we are lightened with God's Word.
sworn: So all the faithful ought to bind themselves to God by a solemn oath and promises to stir up their zeal to embrace God's word.
freewill offerings of my mouth: That is, my prayer and thanksgiving which Hosea calls the calves of the lips, Ho 14:2.
soul is continually in my hand: That is, I am in continual danger of my life.
heritage for ever: I esteemed no worldly things, but made your word my inheritance.
vain thoughts: Whoever will embrace God's word correctly must abhor all fantasies and imaginations both of himself and others.
Depart from me: And hinder me not to keep the law of the Lord.
Hold thou me up: He desires God's continual assistance, lest he should faint in this race, which he had begun.
deceit is falsehood: The crafty practises of them who contemn your law will be brought to nothing.
dross: Which infected your people, as dross does metal.
trembleth for fear of thee: Your judgments not only teach me obedience, but cause me to fear, considering my own weakness which fear causes repentance.
Be surety for thy servant for: Put yourself between me and my enemies, as if you were my pledge.
servant according unto thy mercy: He does not boast that he is God's servant, but by this reminds God that as he made him his by his grace, so he would continue his favour toward him.
time for thee: The prophet shows that when the wicked have brought all things to confusion, and God's word to utter contempt, then it is God's time to help and send remedy.
way: That is, whatever dissents from the purity of your word.
wonderful: Containing high and secret mysteries, so that I am moved with admiration and reverence.
words giveth light: The simple idiots that submit themselves to God have their eyes opened and their minds illuminated, as soon as they begin to read God's word.
panted: My zeal toward your word was so great.
run down mine eyes: He shows what should be the zeal of God's children when they see his word contemned.
righteous and very faithful: We cannot confess God to be righteous, unless we live uprightly and truly as he has commanded.
small and despised: This is the true trial to praise God in adversity.
live: So that the life of man without the knowledge of God is death.
cried with my whole heart: He shows that all his affection and whole heart were bent toward God to have help in his dangers.
prevent the night watches: He was more earnest in the study of God's word, than they who kept the watch were in their charge.
mischief: He shows the nature of the wicked to be to persecute against their conscience.
Concerning thy testimonies: His faith is grounded on God's word, that he would always be at hand when his children are oppressed.
word: For without God's promise there is no hope of deliverance.
judgments: According to your promise made in the law, which because the wicked lack they have no hope of salvation.
grieved: My zeal consumed me when I saw their malice and contempt for your glory.
love thy precepts: It is a sure sign of our adoption, when we love the Law of God.
beginning: Since you first promised it, even to the end all your sayings are true.
persecuted me without a cause: The threatenings and persecutions of princes could not cause me to cease to confess you whom I fear more than men.
Seven times a day do I: That is, often and various times.
love thy law: For their conscience assures them that they please you, whereas they who do not love you have the contrary.
hoped for thy salvation: He shows that we must first have faith before we can work and please God.
for all my ways are before: I had no respect for men, but set you always before my eyes as the judge of my doings.
according to thy word: As you have promised to be the schoolmaster to all who depend on you.
utter praise: The word means to pour forth continually.
taught me thy statutes: All his prayer and desire is to profit in the word of God.
judgments help me: That is, your provident care over me, and with which you will judge my enemies.
gone astray like a lost sheep: Being chased to and fro by my enemies, and having no place to rest in.
